posts.title: Highlights and notes from the Fable/Mythos System Card
posts.description: TL;DR: I turned Anthropic’s docs and system cards into an e-book for my Kobo. Here I share my notes and comments, mostly on interpretability. posts.title: My “Rally Adventure” one-shot game, made with Opus 5 medium thinking
posts.description: TL;DR: I gave Claude Opus a single prompt asking for an off-road driving game with a retro Screamer Rally look, and let it fan out sub-agents. A few hours later I had Rally Adventure: Three.js, TypeScript and Rapier, every texture and every sound generated in code.
